content.comment_body: Hello, I would like some advice on changing the state of a digital flag during simulation. I'm using flag M2 as an input for an AND block and want to set this input to 1. Under normal circumstances, this bit is managed by the operator panel. I've tried updating M2 through data table [article_no].1, but that approach doesn't work. Are there alternative solutions? I appreciate your feedback.
Thank you very much, that was extremely helpful! :)

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked for instructions on how to update a digital flag in simulation, specifically for flag M2 used in an AND block. The attempted method, setting the value via data table [article_no].1, was unsuccessful, highlighting potential difficulties in manipulating flags while simulating. Another user responded by sharing a visual guide, which the original poster found valuable.
